loss_spans: `pytest <tmp_path>/probe.py -c orchestrator/pyproject.toml` sets confcutdir to the inifile's dir, and `PytestPluginManager._is_in_confcutdir(p)` is literally `p not in confcutdir.parents`.
So /tmp and every dir under it count as "inside" (only `/` is excluded).
(2) Any conftest.py in /tmp, /tmp/pytest-of-leo, … gets IMPORTED into the probe, which is a contamination hazard.
FIX: pass `--confcutdir=<probe's own dir>` (with the probe in a subdir of tmp_path).
This bounds both conftest discovery and the collection root.
The probe can stay in tmp_path, with no in-repo scratch dir to clean up.
reason: PARENT says a nested `pytest -c <subproject>/pyproject.toml` probe on a /tmp file is slow from a wide collection sweep and fixes it by putting the probe in the subproject tree, and CHILD gives the precise confcutdir mechanism for the same slow probe plus a --confcutdir fix; PARENT's fix still works, but someone relying on it would miss the conftest-import contamination hazard and the in-tmp_path fix.
